messages.text: ok so stack check! 🖥️ i'm thinking vite + react 18 obviously. but can we please use tailwind? my hands itch for utility classes.
react/vite yes. tailwind no. mei sent me a moodboard and it's very specific with those turquoise gradients. tailwind will fight us on spacing and color tokens.
aww but i love tailwind 😭 okay fine. plain css it is? just need to agree on a naming convention so we don't have .button vs .btn chaos
design tokens. :root variables. --color-primary, --space-4 etc. keeps it consistent with mei's sketches and no magic numbers.
deal. i'll set up the token structure when i scaffold tomorrow. what about component lib? shadcn?
no. just react components. if we bring in a lib we spend 2 hours fighting types and theming. we have 48 hours of build time later, not weeks.
true. lean is good. so routes? i'm thinking home, import, view/:id, search, settings. does that cover the flow?
home is the atlas canvas right? import is where they paste interests? view is the detail page with the 'why you connect' explanation.
yes! and search can just be a filter on the home view or its own route? i'm leaning separate route so we can have a dedicated input bar.
separate route. settings is just profile + privacy toggles. anything else? chen said auth needs to be simple but secure.
oh right auth. how are we doing it? oauth? email magic links?
chen's thinking session cookies + http only. no heavy oauth stack for a hackathon demo. keeps the infra light.
makes sense. i'll build the auth UI around that assumption then. login/signup pages basically?
yes. i'll handle the api side tomorrow. you focus on the shell + tokens. we sync after dinner.
perfect. setting up vite now 🚀 see you at 9!
gl. don't forget to commit the token file early so mei can review it.
